title: $\RHom$ preserves bounded constructible complexes ($\ell$-adic $\Lambda$)
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be one of $\underline{\cO}_E$, $\underline E$ ($E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite;
[sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]) or $\underline{\Qlb}$ ([sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed]), and let $X$
be a scheme of the setting of [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. If $K,L\in D(\Mod_{\Lambda_X})$ are bounded
constructible ([sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible]), then so is $\RHom_{\Lambda_X}(K,L)$
([sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]).

external.place: Since $K$ is bounded constructible, reduction modulo $\varpi$ gives $$ \RHom(K,L)/\varpi\cong\RHom_{\cO_E/\varpi}(K/\varpi,L/\varpi). $$ By Deligne's finiteness theorem for the internal $\RHom$ (SGA 4½, *Th. finitude*, 1.6) on the finite type $k$-scheme $X$, with coefficients in which $p$ is invertible, this is a bounded complex with constructible cohomology.

The cases $\underline E$ and $\underline{\Qlb}$ follow by inverting $\ell$ and by descending to a finite extension $E$ ([sk-thm-sfb-qlbar-two-colimit]), as in [lem-sfb-dc-lower-star-preserves]; see Bhatt–Scholze, §6.8.

The cases $\underline E$ and $\underline{\Qlb}$ follow by inverting $\ell$ and by descending to a finite extension $E$ ([sk-thm-sfb-qlbar-two-colimit]), as in [lem-sfb-dc-lower-star-preserves]; see Bhatt–Scholze, §6.8.

proof.text: Apply Module.Finite.small over ℚ_ℓ and transport the finite normed extension to Shrink E : Type 0. The ring equivalence preserves norms and is continuous with continuous inverse. Pull the closed unit ball back along this equivalence, preserving its norm characterization.

Postcomposition gives explicit inverse isomorphisms of continuous coefficient ring sheaves. Pull them to X. Restriction of scalars along either pulled-back ring isomorphism preserves and reflects finite local presentations, stratum by stratum, and therefore bounded constructibility. Its exact derived equivalence is strong monoidal; conjugating tensor-Hom adjunctions and uniqueness of right adjoints identify its internal Homs.

Apply the existing Type 0 class-indexed isMonoidalClosed_boundedConstructible instance to the small field and its closed unit ball. Transport both closure conclusions back along the coefficient-ring isomorphisms. The imported instance also retains the algebraic-closure case.
